marble_root_media_boot.img.unixnu.toml:
version = 1
[boot]
timeout = 3
default = "marble"
[kits]
autoload = false
[[driver]]
path = "Payloads/DarwinBoot.efi"
[[entry]]
id = "marble"
title = "UniXNU"
type = "xnu"
path = "Payloads/kernel.macho"
args = "-v serial=0 debug=0x14e cpus=1 armcpu-diagnostics=1 -no_slto_panic early_console=1 -enable_kprintf_spam startup_debug=1 sheng-pmgr=2"
